title: What data infrastructure supports the Joz world model?
summary: A controlled PostgreSQL trajectory pipeline with privacy-safe JSONL export and leakage-resistant splits.
body: The system stores versioned, classified and privacy-minimised trajectories in PostgreSQL, applies sampling, payload, rollout, timeout and retention controls, excludes configured bot and development traffic, uses pseudonymous sessions and exports checksum-verified JSONL with session-isolated train, validation and test splits.
